Your first steps with Clara

Bring your product, set the context, and choose your first piece.

On this pageBefore you beginBring one product into focusGive Clara something to work fromMake a first draftMeet Agents and WorkflowsReview before you share

Before you begin

You’ll need access to a Clara workspace. If you’re new here, request early access.

Bring one product into focus

Open Products and choose the product you’re working on. Start with a clear description: what it does, who uses it, and the problem it helps them solve. Keep your first task focused on one product and one audience.

Give Clara something to work from

Open Brand & knowledge. Add your voice, audience, and writing guidelines, then bring in relevant product sources. A current overview and a specific release note make a useful starting point.

Set up your brand and knowledge →

Make a first draft

Open Plays and choose a format, such as a LinkedIn post or blog article. Give Clara a short brief about what changed and why it matters. You can also start a conversation through New chat.

Write a LinkedIn post about our new shared project view. Speak to small product teams. Explain how it helps them see the next step, using the attached release notes.

Meet Agents and Workflows

After your first draft, open Agents for recurring marketing roles and Workflows for the jobs behind them. Choose how independently they run in Settings → Autonomy.

Build your marketing team →

Review before you share

Open the resulting work, check its claims against your sources, and refine the wording. A completed generation is a draft to assess. Check the destination and any connected publishing action before approving it.
